summary_1line: Narada explains that a Shudra performing forbidden ascetic penance in Rama’s realm has caused cosmic disorder leading to a brahmin child’s untimely death.

image_candidates.scene_text: A grieving brahmin clutches his dead child before King Rama’s court while sages and ministers gather in solemn silence.
The sage Narada rises among assembled rishis in Rama’s hall, explaining the cosmic law that links a child’s death to forbidden penance.
An austere Shudra ascetic performs severe penance alone in the wilderness, symbolizing the disruption of cosmic order.
